steps.npc: Well hello there; welcome to our little village. Pray, stay awhile.

options.text: You know, you sound just like the mayor?

steps.player: You know, you sound just like the mayor?

steps.npc: Really? That's the nicest thing anyone has ever said.
I admire him a great deal. He works so hard for this town.

steps.player: You look like him as well?

steps.npc: Hmm, I don't think I do.

steps.player: No really, what with the unhealthy skin tone and bulging eyes. The resemblance is uncanny.

steps.npc: Well, I haven't spoken to him in a while.  I don't get out much.
Maybe the Mayor has finally seen how much I admire him and has grown to admire me?

steps.player: Anything's possible I suppose. Wait a minute, you mean you've always looked that odd?

steps.npc: I supply the local fishermen with the tools and bait they need to do their job.

steps.player: Interesting. Have you been doing it long?

steps.npc: Why yes, all of my life.  I took over from my father, who inherited the business from his father and so on.
In fact, there have been Lovecraft's selling bait for over ten generations.
Oh yes, we have a long and interesting family history. For one reason or another the Lovecraft's have always been bait sellers or writers.

steps.player: Hmm, yes well. I'm sure it's all fascinating, but I...

steps.npc: Oh very, very fascinating, for instance my great grandfather Howard...

steps.player: Yawn. Oh, I'm sorry but I really must be getting on. I think my giraffe needs feeding.
Giraffe. Sorry, but he gets cranky without enough sugar. Bye now!

options.text: Can I buy some fishing supplies please?

steps.player: Can I buy some fishing supplies please?

options.text: You are a bit too strange for me. Bye.

steps.player: You are a bit too strange for me. Bye.
